disorder-name.detail: Self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes (formerly benign Rolandic epilepsy); diagnosed by two experienced neurologists per ILAE classifications; pediatric case-control cohort.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The case-control cohort comprised 187 children with SeLECTS, including 98 boys and 89 girls, aged 4 to 18 years, with a mean age of 9.09 ± 2.66 years."

dataset-of-origin.detail: The case-control cohort (SeLECTS patients and matched controls) was collected from a single Chinese institution. Data availability states raw data are available on request from the corresponding author (Zhiqiang Zhang, Nanjing Jinling Hospital). Ethics committee ID: 2018NZKY-020-02. No named public dataset was used for the clinical cohort.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The raw data of children with SeLECTS and controls in this study are available on request from the corresponding author." "The ID of the case-control cohort from the approving ethics committee is 2018NZKY-020-02"
